services.name: Open Doors Program
services.desc: At Small World Music, we believe music connects us all and we’re committed to making live music more accessible.Through our Open Doors Program, we offer a limited number of discounted tickets for $25 or less to select shows to help reduce financial barriers. These tickets are for anyone who may face obstacles attending, including students, newcomers, artists, or anyone navigating a difficult moment.
